prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-52806 Pending
prose.body:
Hi Team Fallowfield Games,

Hope you’re having a productive week! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-52806 for the recent services provided. The amount due is 772.06 USDC.

As per our standard arrangement, please send the payment to our usual vendor wallet: 0xd0ea65f7acb2d2eb5aa02a76af0c02e9c9934d42.

If you’ve already sent the payment, please feel free to ignore this note. If you have any questions or need the invoice resent, just let us know. We appreciate your prompt attention and look forward to continuing our great collaboration.

Best regards,

The Cobalt Cloud Billing Team
